d: In this episode of Tarikh, we uncover the fascinating history of Mashhad, Iran's holiest city and the final resting place of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Discover why Imam Reza Shrine, the burial place of Shia Islam's eighth Imam, became one of the world's most important pilgrimage sites. Explore the legacy of Nader Shah, the story of the Koh-i-Noor diamond, the city's connection with the Mughal Empire, and the impact of the Mongol invasions.
